name: Create a season
description: Admin only. ONE STATEMENT creates the season -- number last+1, the engine pinned from games.active_engine_digest, the window and the rules -- carries every active baseline of the previous season into it at the prior with its seed events, and bumps the roster epoch. Three refusals, told apart by `why`: a season of the game is still live, the opening date is inside season_gap_days of the previous close, or the game has no engine declared. Participant handles are resolved to user ids first, because a handle can change and an id cannot. WEIGHT CLASSES ARE THE SEASON'S: absent from the body, it inherits the previous season's table rather than a constant, and the carry-forward is filtered by them, so a nano-only season carries the nano baselines and leaves the rest behind instead of seating a `large` version on a ladder that does not exist.

input.query: SELECT json_build_object('id', u.id, 'role', u.role) AS body FROM users u JOIN live_sessions s ON s.user_id = u.id AND s.sid = ($2)::uuid WHERE u.id = ($1)::uuid

tasks.name: Admins only
tasks.description: The role is read off the live session rather than off a claim in the cookie, so revoking a session or demoting a user takes effect on the next request.

logic.detail: submissions_open_at and submissions_close_at are required, as ISO-8601 timestamps.

input.query: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(u.id::text ORDER BY u.handle), '[]'::jsonb) AS ids FROM users u WHERE u.handle = ANY (($1)::text[])

tasks.name: Put the ids on the rule
Create the season and carry the baselines

input.query: WITH game AS ( SELECT g.id, g.active_engine_digest FROM games g WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text ), last AS ( SELECT max(s.number) AS number, max(s.closed_at) AS closed_at FROM seasons s JOIN game ON game.id = s.game_id ), created AS ( INSERT INTO seasons (game_id, number, engine_digest, submissions_open_at, submissions_close_at, rules, weight_classes) SELECT game.id, coalesce(last.number, 0) + 1, game.active_engine_digest, ($2)::timestamptz, ($3)::timestamptz, coalesce(($7)::jsonb, '{}'::jsonb), coalesce(($8)::jsonb, (SELECT s.weight_classes FROM seasons s WHERE s.game_id = game.id ORDER BY s.number DESC LIMIT 1), '[{"class": "nano", "max_bytes": 8192}, {"class": "micro", "max_bytes": 65536}, {"class": "mini", "max_bytes": 524288}, {"class": "small", "max_bytes": 4194304}, {"class": "large", "max_bytes": 67108864}]'::jsonb) FROM game, last WHERE game.active_engine_digest IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM seasons s WHERE s.game_id = game.id AND s.closed_at IS NULL) AND ($2)::timestamptz >= coalesce(last.closed_at, '-infinity'::timestamptz) + make_interval(days => ($4)::int) RETURNING id, number, game_id, weight_classes ), carried AS ( INSERT INTO models (owner_id, game_id, season_id, version, repo, release_tag, commit_sha, status, weight_class, size_bytes, param_count, infer_us, weights_hash, adapter_hash, adapter, evaluator_digest) SELECT b.owner_id, b.game_id, created.id, (SELECT max(x.version) FROM models x WHERE x.owner_id = b.owner_id AND x.game_id = b.game_id) + 1, b.repo, b.release_tag, b.commit_sha, 'active', b.weight_class, b.size_bytes, b.param_count, b.infer_us, b.weights_hash, b.adapter_hash, b.adapter, b.evaluator_digest FROM created JOIN seasons prev ON prev.game_id = created.game_id AND prev.number = created.number - 1 JOIN models b ON b.season_id = prev.id AND b.status = 'active' AND b.weight_class::text IN (SELECT e ->> 'class' FROM created, jsonb_array_elements(created.weight_classes) AS e) JOIN users u ON u.id = b.owner_id AND u.role = 'baseline' RETURNING id, weight_class ), seeded AS ( INSERT INTO ratings (model_id, ladder, mu, sigma) SELECT c.id, l.ladder, ($5)::float8, ($6)::float8 FROM carried c CROSS JOIN LATERAL (VALUES (c.weight_class), ('open'::ladder)) AS l (ladder) RETURNING model_id, ladder, mu, sigma ), events AS ( INSERT INTO rating_events (model_id, ladder, seq, mu_after, sigma_after) SELECT model_id, ladder, 0, mu, sigma FROM seeded RETURNING model_id ) UPDATE clocks c SET epoch = c.epoch + 1, updated_at = now() FROM created WHERE c.key = 'roster'

SELECT json_build_object( 'live', (SELECT json_build_object('number', s.number, 'closed_at', s.closed_at) FROM seasons s WHERE s.game_id = g.id AND s.closed_at IS NULL), 'earliest_open', (SELECT max(s.closed_at) + make_interval(days => ($2)::int) FROM seasons s WHERE s.game_id = g.id), 'engine', g.active_engine_digest IS NOT NULL) AS body FROM games g WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text
SELECT season_json(s) AS body FROM games g, current_season(g.id) s WHERE g.slug = ($1)::text
